name: China Silver Group Limited
summary: China Silver Group Limited is a Shenzhen-headquartered investment holding company founded by Chen Wan Tian in 2002. It makes and sells silver and other non-ferrous metals and runs jewellery brands such as Mojit, Myray, Murat, Forain and Yiyi Jewelry. Its manufacturing segment sells silver ingots and non-ferrous metals in China, and its new jewellery retail segment designs and sells gold, silver and gemstone jewellery.
